```{r}
   clean_names %>%
   #remove Name numbers that have longer than 3 digits:

   #keep only carbon_average  , nitrogen_average, name
   select(carbon_average, nitrogen_average, name, date) %>%
   #keep number values in averages but remove percent and change to numeric

    #remove failed samples yayyyy:

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

carbon_data_clean <- carbon_data %>%
  # Convert date to proper date format (month/day/year)
  mutate(date = mdy(date)) %>%
  # Group by sample ID (name)
  group_by(name) %>%
  # Keep only the *latest* measurement per sample
  arrange(desc(date), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

#plot carbon_data_clean

  labs(title = "Carbon Average by date",

  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#merge with soil data with carbon_data_clean with soil ID in soil_data, and name in carbon_data_clean. Keep in mind that name only includes the last 3 digits of soil ID.
merged_data <- soil_data %>%
  mutate(soil_id_last3 = as.integer(substr(as.character(ID), nchar(as.character(ID)) - 2, nchar(as.character(ID))))) %>%
  inner_join(carbon_data_clean, by = c("soil_id_last3" = "leco_name"))
#save csv
write.csv(merged_data, "../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/carbon/soil_data_with_CN.csv", row.names = FALSE)
#plot map of merged_data with x and y coordinates, colored and labelled by leco_carbon_average
merged_data_SPID <- merged_data %>%
  filter(type == "SPID")
merged_data_CID <- merged_data %>%
  filter(type == "CID")
#now, do leaflet with satellite basemap to plot type ==SPID points with leco_carbon_average as color and label.
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.providers)
#just SPID red gradient:
leaflet(data = merged_data_SPID) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(~x, ~y,
                   color = ~colorNumeric("YlOrRd", leco_carbon_average)(leco_carbon_average),
                   label = ~paste("Carbon Average:", leco_carbon_average),
                   radius = 5,
                   fillOpacity = 0.8) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright",
            pal = colorNumeric("YlOrRd", merged_data_SPID$leco_carbon_average),
            values = merged_data_SPID$leco_carbon_average,
            title = "Composite Carbon Average (%)",
            opacity = 1)
#just CID blue gradient:
leaflet(data = merged_data_CID) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(~x, ~y,
                   color = ~colorNumeric("YlGnBu", leco_carbon_average)(leco_carbon_average),
                   label = ~paste("Carbon Average:", leco_carbon_average),
                   radius = 5,
                   fillOpacity = 0.8) %>%
  addLegend("bottomright",
            pal = colorNumeric("YlGnBu", merged_data_CID$leco_carbon_average),
            values = merged_data_CID$leco_carbon_average,
            title = "Composite Carbon Average (%)",
            opacity = 1)
```

```{r}
#density plots of SPID carbon and CID carbon
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = leco_carbon_average, fill = type)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Density Plot of SOC % by Sample Type",
       x = "SOC (%)",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SPID" = "red", "CID" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal()

#plot nitrogen density of SPID and CID
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = leco_nitrogen_average, fill = type)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Density Plot of Nitrogen % by Sample Type",
       x = "Nitrogen (%)",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SPID" = "red", "CID" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal()

#plot pointlabel and SOC and color by sample type, SPID is single point and CID is composite
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = PointLabel, y = leco_carbon_average, color = type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "SOC % by Sample Point",
       x = "Sample Point Label",
       y = "SOC (%)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SPID" = "red", "CID" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))




#plot carbon avg differences for SPID and CID for each Point label

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

carbon_diff <- merged_data %>%
  # Clean carbon to numeric
  mutate(leco_carbon_average = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", leco_carbon_average))) %>%
  
  # Only use SPID and CID rows
  filter(type %in% c("SPID", "CID")) %>% 
  
  # Summarize in case there are duplicates (take mean)
  group_by(PointLabel, type) %>%
  summarise(leco_carbon_average = mean(leco_carbon_average, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Pivot so SPID and CID become columns
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = leco_carbon_average) %>%
  
  # Remove labels where one is missing
  drop_na(SPID, CID) %>%
  
  # Calculate difference
  mutate(carbon_diff = SPID - CID)

# Plot
ggplot(carbon_diff, aes(x = reorder(PointLabel, carbon_diff), y = carbon_diff)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Carbon Difference (SPID - CID) by Point Label",
       x = "Point Label",
       y = "Difference in Carbon (%)") +
  theme_minimal()


library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

plot_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(leco_carbon_average = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", leco_carbon_average))) %>%
  filter(type %in% c("SPID", "CID"))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = PointLabel, y = leco_carbon_average, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = type), 
              width = 0.15, height = 0,
              alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SPID" = "#1f78b4", "CID" = "#e31a1c")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SPID" = "#1f78b4", "CID" = "#e31a1c")) +
  labs(title = "Soil Organic Carbon Distribution by PointLabel",
       x = "Point Label",
       y = "Carbon (%)",
       fill = "Sample Type",
       color = "Sample Type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  coord_flip()
```
